about.title: About Us
about.description: windnote.ai focuses on a secure, clean, and efficient chat experience. Stay connected with friends, groups, and circle members while keeping control of your profile, privacy settings, and signed-in devices.
about.capabilityChat: Reliable one-to-one chats, group chats, voice messages, media messages, and local chat record management.
about.capabilityPrivacy: Login security code, device management, blacklist, profile visibility, and stranger message controls.
about.capabilityCircle: Ongoing improvements to circle interactions, note sharing, friend relationships, and the notification center.
about.privacyBody: Chat content, device sessions, and profile information are protected according to your settings. Key controls live in account and privacy settings so you can manage who may contact you, what profile details are visible, and which devices remain signed in.
about.agreementSummary: Learn about account use, content publishing, and community rules.
about.agreementBody:
1. Scope
This agreement applies when you register, sign in to, access, or use windnote.ai and its related features, including instant messaging, group chats, circle interactions, profile display, login device management, and security settings. By using the service, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to this agreement.

2. Account and Security
You should provide true, lawful, and valid information when registering, and you are responsible for keeping your account, password, login security code, and devices secure. Losses caused by disclosing, transferring, lending, or failing to safeguard your credentials are your responsibility. If you discover abnormal login activity, account misuse, or other security risks, you should promptly change your password, remove abnormal devices, or contact us.

3. User Conduct
You may not use the service to publish, transmit, store, or share content or conduct that violates laws, public order, good customs, or the legitimate rights of others; harasses others; induces fraud; conducts malicious marketing; compromises platform security; or disrupts normal operation of the service. Depending on the severity, we may remove content, restrict features, suspend, or terminate accounts as necessary.

4. Content and Intellectual Property
You retain lawful rights in content you publish through the service, while granting windnote.ai a necessary license to use such content for providing, maintaining, displaying, distributing, backing up, and improving the service. windnote.ai software, interface, marks, technical solutions, and service content are protected by intellectual property laws and may not be copied, reverse engineered, modified, distributed, or commercially used without permission.

5. Service Changes, Suspension, and Termination
We may optimize the service and adjust, suspend, or terminate certain features due to version upgrades, system maintenance, network failures, third-party service issues, force majeure, or compliance requirements. We will make reasonable efforts to notify you in advance or in a timely manner, but we are not liable beyond the scope required by law for service unavailability not caused by our intentional misconduct or gross negligence.

6. Liability and Disputes
You are responsible for actions taken through your account and their consequences. Disputes, losses, or liabilities caused by your violation of this agreement, laws, or third-party rights are your responsibility; if windnote.ai or others suffer losses as a result, you shall compensate them in accordance with law. The formation, performance, interpretation, and dispute resolution of this agreement are governed by the laws of the People's Republic of China.
about.policySummary: Learn how profile, session, and device security information is handled.
about.policyBody:
1. Scope
This privacy policy applies to windnote.ai's processing of personal information when you register, sign in, and use chat, group chat, circle, profile display, security management, notification, and related features. We follow the principles of lawfulness, legitimacy, necessity, good faith, openness, and transparency when explaining the purposes, methods, scope, and retention period of personal information processing.

2. Collection and Use of Personal Information
To provide basic services, we may process account identifiers, nickname, avatar, profile information, friend relationships, group relationships, message content, and necessary message metadata. To protect account and service security, we may process login device information, network status, IP address, operation logs, security code status, and abnormal login records. Camera, photo library, microphone, location, and notification permissions are used only when you actively use related features and grant authorization; you may manage or withdraw permissions in system settings.

3. Processing Purposes
We process personal information mainly to register and sign in accounts, send and receive messages, synchronize conversations, display profiles, manage friends and blacklists, identify login devices, protect account security, send service notices, handle complaints and reports, comply with laws, and improve product experience. Unless otherwise required by law or with your separate consent, we will not process your personal information beyond these purposes.

4. Sharing, Transfer, and Public Disclosure
We do not sell your personal information. To provide necessary features, we may entrust cloud service, push notification, storage, risk control, or analytics providers to process information within a controlled scope, and require them to process it according to agreed purposes, periods, methods, and security measures. Where providing information to another personal information processor, public disclosure, processing sensitive personal information, or separate consent is required by law, we will provide required notice and obtain necessary authorization.

5. Retention and Security
We retain personal information only for the shortest period necessary to achieve the processing purposes, unless laws require otherwise or retention is necessary for dispute resolution or security protection. We use access control, transmission encryption, permission isolation, log auditing, and security monitoring to protect information, but the internet is not absolutely secure; you should also keep your account, password, and login security code safe.

6. User Rights
You may lawfully access, correct, supplement, delete, copy, or request deletion of personal information; withdraw consent; cancel your account; and manage profile visibility, blacklist, signed-in devices, and security code. Due to laws, technical implementation, account security, or contractual necessity, some requests may not be fulfilled immediately, but we will explain the reason within a reasonable period and provide feasible handling methods.

7. Protection of Minors
If you are under the age of 14, you should use the service with the consent and guidance of your guardian. We do not intentionally collect unnecessary personal information from minors. If a guardian discovers that a minor's information has been processed without consent, the guardian may contact us to correct or delete it.

8. Policy Updates
We may update this policy based on changes in laws, product features, or processing rules. For material changes, we will notify you through page prompts, system notices, or other reasonable methods. Your continued use of the service indicates that you understand and accept the updated privacy policy.
